name: Treegrid
description: A hierarchical data grid where rows can be expanded/collapsed and both rows and individual cells are focusable and interactive.

keyboard_interactions.action: Expands/collapses child rows or performs default cell action
Expands collapsed row; moves to first cell; or moves one cell right
Collapses expanded row; moves to row header; or moves one cell left
Moves one row or cell down
Moves one row or cell up
Moves to first row or first cell in current row
Moves to last row or last cell in current row
Moves to first row or top cell in column
Moves to last row or bottom cell in column

required_attributes.description: true when open; false when closed

optional_attributes.description: Nesting depth (when not inferable from DOM)

notes: A treegrid is a grid whose rows are hierarchical — read patterns/grid.md and patterns/treeview.md first; this is their intersection and adds no new ideas, only more surface.
This is the most complex pattern in the APG. If a treeview or a plain grid will do, use that instead. Almost every 'treegrid' in the wild would have been better as an expandable table.
aria-expanded goes on the ROW (role='row'), not on a cell.
aria-level, aria-posinset and aria-setsize go on the row and are mandatory: unlike a treeview, the DOM is flat, so nothing else conveys the hierarchy.
Two navigation modes: row-focus (arrows move between rows) and cell-focus (arrows move between cells). Enter switches into a row; Escape returns to row-focus. Pick one model and be consistent.
Collapsed child rows must be removed or `hidden` — not merely visually collapsed (RAWeb 10.8).

raweb_criteria.reason: treegrid/row/gridcell roles plus aria-expanded and aria-level must be exposed.
Two-dimensional arrow navigation plus expand/collapse, all from the keyboard.
The focused cell or row must be visibly indicated.
Collapsed rows must be hidden from assistive technologies.
Tab must escape; arrows navigate inside.
If it renders as a table with headers, those headers must still be properly declared.
